## Next action

Work out why roughly half the site's pages have never been fetched by Google. At
the 2026-08-10 check a large share of URLs were not merely unindexed but never
crawled, which is a discovery problem rather than a quality one.

## State

Portfolio for To Yin Yu, live at www.toyinyu.com. Next.js with Tailwind and
Framer Motion. The performance regression is fixed and shipped: the aurora shader
running on software WebGL was the entire cost, and removing it took the Lighthouse
performance score from poor to top.

**The default branch here is `master`, not `main`.**

`src/lib/projects.data.json` is the single source of truth for the project roster.
The live site, the résumé PDF, and `PROJECTS_OVERVIEW.md` are all derived from it
via the `update-portfolio` skill. Edit the JSON, then cascade; do not hand-edit the
derived copies.

## Gotchas

Calling `cookies()` in the root layout makes **every** route dynamic. That is how
the theme is server-rendered without a flash, so it is deliberate, but it means
nothing on this site is statically cached. Check that assumption before debugging
a caching question.

The homepage bento cards are hand-curated in the page, not generated from
`projects.ts`. Adding a project to the data does not put it on the homepage.

Do not run `vercel --prod`. It does not move the production alias.
